growth_thesis.basis: Stated figures; the contribution of the share count is inferred from the two share figures.
growth_thesis.claim: Per-share growth was helped by a lower share count: record diluted EPS of $3.03 (up $0.48), with weighted diluted shares at 61,971 against 63,815 a year earlier (table in thousands). Continuation would need repurchases and earnings to persist.
quotes: Delivers record fiscal 2026 GAAP EPS of $3.03 and record non-GAAP EPS of $3.00

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the release; the non-repeatable reading is inferred from the company's own description of the refunds as infrequent.
growth_thesis.claim: Part of the reported profit growth is not repeatable: GAAP operating income rose 14% to $286 million, but non-GAAP operating income rose 8% to $285 million, because tariff refunds added $24 million of gross profit and offset closure charges. Underlying growth depends on margin gains, not further refunds.
quotes: Central recognized incremental gross profit of $24 million for tariff refunds received

growth_thesis.claim: The company's own outlook limits near-term growth: it guides next-fiscal-year non-GAAP EPS to $2.65 or better, below the $3.00 just reported. It expects a challenging first quarter, and it counts Burpee and TRIXIE with minimal EPS contribution.
quotes: It also anticipates a challenging first quarter, with opportunities for improvement as the year progresses.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the 10-K risk factors; the link to the Garden listings gains is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Growth depends on a few large retailers: in the prior fiscal year Walmart was about 17% and Home Depot about 16% of net sales, and together with Costco, Lowe's and Amazon the five were about 54%. Retailer listings and shelf space therefore must hold.
quotes: We depend on a few customers for a significant portion of our business.

material_events.basis: stated in P4; the cash proceeds and gain on divestiture also appear in the cash flow statement F3
material_events.claim: Central contributed its pet distribution business to a new partnership with Phillips Pet Food & Supplies. It received cash proceeds of about $31 million and a 20% ownership interest, and recognized a small pre-tax gain.
quotes: On April 13, 2026, we entered into a strategic partnership with Phillips Pet Food & Supplies

material_events.claim: Central announced an agreement to acquire 80% of TRIXIE, a European pet supplies company, for total consideration of up to €400 million. Closing needs regulatory approval and is expected in the second quarter of fiscal 2027.
quotes: to acquire 80% of the outstanding shares of TRIXIE Heimtierbedarf GmbH & Co. KG
The transaction is expected to close in the second quarter of fiscal 2027.

material_events.basis: stated in the 8-K earnings release P6
material_events.claim: Central completed its acquisition of W. Atlee Burpee Company, a packet seed and young plant brand, after fiscal year end.
quotes: The transaction closed on September 30, 2026.

material_events.basis: stated in P4; the purchase price and size are not given in the cited text
material_events.claim: Central acquired Champion, which the 10-Q treats as an acquisition affecting organic net sales comparisons.
quotes: the acquisition of Champion in December 2025

material_events.basis: stated in P6; the exact receipt dates are not given
material_events.claim: In fiscal 2026 Central received tariff refunds that added to gross profit, including a portion received in the fourth quarter. The company excludes them from its non-GAAP results.
quotes: Offsetting these charges, Central recognized incremental gross profit of $24 million for tariff refunds received, of which $22 million was recognized in its Pet segment and $2 million in its Garden segment.

risks.basis: stated in the earnings release; the causal link to future results is inferred
risks.claim: Organic demand weakened sharply in the latest quarter: net sales fell 21% to $537 million and organic net sales fell 6%, with the Pet segment citing softer consumer demand, lost pet-bed distribution and a supply constraint.
quotes: Net sales decreased 21% to $537 million, while organic net sales decreased 6%.

The decrease in organic net sales was due to softer consumer demand in certain categories, lost distribution in lower-margin pet beds and a temporary supply constraint in one of Central's pet businesses.

risks.basis: stated in the release; the reading of a step-down is inferred from comparing the two figures
risks.claim: Management's outlook for non-GAAP EPS of $2.65 or better compares with $3.00 non-GAAP EPS in the year just reported, so the outlook implies lower earnings. Management cites a prudent view of market conditions and a challenging first quarter.
quotes: Expects fiscal 2027 non-GAAP EPS of $2.65 or better
Delivers record fiscal 2026 GAAP EPS of $3.03 and record non-GAAP EPS of $3.00

risks.basis: stated in the 10-Q and the release; the risk framing is inferred
risks.claim: The TRIXIE acquisition (about €340 million in cash at closing, up to €400 million total) has not closed. It needs regulatory approval, and integration or purchase-accounting costs could burden results.
quotes: The consummation of the Company’s acquisition of TRIXIE is subject to regulatory approval and other customary closing conditions.

risks.basis: stated in the release; the repeatability concern is inferred
risks.claim: Reported fourth-quarter GAAP gross profit was lifted by tariff refunds. Excluding them, gross profit fell 8% to $182 million, against a GAAP increase of 3%. This leaves the quality and repeatability of reported earnings uncertain.
quotes: On a non-GAAP basis, which excludes tariff refunds received during the fourth quarter, gross profit decreased 8% to $182 million, with gross margin expanding 480 basis points to 33.9%.

risks.basis: stated in the release; whether the filing was completed is not in the evidence
risks.claim: The fiscal-year results in the earnings release are preliminary because the annual Form 10-K had not been filed when the release was issued. They could change if adjustments are identified before filing.
quotes: Central has not filed its Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 26, 2026.

risks.basis: stated in the release and 10-Q; the broader vendor-risk framing is inferred
risks.claim: Garden net sales fell 7% to $232 million in the fourth quarter, partly because a vendor chose to sell directly to retailers. A product-line distribution loss was also cited in the third quarter. Reliance on third-party vendors for distribution sales is exposed to such losses.
quotes: Net sales in the Garden segment decreased 7% to $232 million, due to unfavorable weather for Live Plants, and lower sales in Central's distribution business resulting from a vendor's decision to sell directly to retailers.

risks.claim: The 10-K says Walmart and Home Depot accounted for about 17% and 16% of net sales, and the five largest retailers about 54%. The loss or weakening of one relationship could hurt sales, operating income and cash flow.
quotes: We depend on a few customers for a significant portion of our business.

risks.basis: stated in the release and 10-Q; future loss trajectory is inferred
risks.claim: The new pet distribution partnership is producing losses for Central. Other expense rose to $9 million in the fourth quarter, driven mainly by Central's share of initial partnership losses, and Central holds a 20% stake valued at $26 million.
quotes: Other expense increased $8 million to $9 million, driven primarily by Central's share of initial losses from the pet distribution partnership.

unresolved_questions.basis: Stated in the release (P6); the size of each driver is not stated.
unresolved_questions.claim: What explains the step down from FY2026 non-GAAP EPS of $3.00 to FY2027 guidance of $2.65 or better, and how much comes from purchase accounting, a weak first quarter and tariffs? The release gives no bridge.
quotes: Expects fiscal 2027 non-GAAP EPS of $2.65 or better
It also anticipates a challenging first quarter, with opportunities for improvement as the year progresses.

unresolved_questions.basis: Refund amounts are stated in P6; whether more refunds are pending is not in the evidence.
unresolved_questions.claim: Are the tariff refunds a one-time item, or will more refunds or new tariffs change FY2027 gross margin? Refunds of $24.1 million were excluded from non-GAAP results, and $20 million of them arrived in Q4.
quotes: During fiscal 2026, we recognized incremental income of $24.1 million in the consolidated statement of operations for tariff refunds received, of which $22.0 million was recognized in our Pet segment and $2.1 million in our Garden segment.
This outlook excludes the impact of any other acquisitions, divestitures or restructuring activities that may occur during fiscal 2027 and any further tariffs.

all financial results described here should be considered preliminary, and are subject to change to reflect any necessary adjustments or changes in accounting estimates that are identified prior to the time we file the Form 10-K

quotes: Net leverage was 0.2x.
